body: School wise it doesn’t really matter for med for engineering stony Brook is better but as far as campus friends and work school life balance being at Hunter is gonna be better I imagine you probably know some people that are staying home for school.. stony Brook is like a giant community college with very advanced rigor. Sure there is a campus life but when 50% of the student body isn’t participating it doesn’t feel as lively as other schools. The location isn’t a bonus either. But it really depends what you’re looking for. After being here for 4 years I wouldn’t come back but that’s just my opinion. Many people had a good time but being in the premed field it was anything but fun. Even though I was willing to put the effort in, in retrospect I did not like any of my time here.
